tools.name: sap_mm_get_material_master
tools.description: Retrieve SAP MM material master data (MM03 equivalent) by material number, including description, material group, base unit, and criticality class.

tools.name: sap_mm_get_stock_overview
tools.description: Retrieve current stock overview (MMBE equivalent) for a material at a plant/storage location, including unrestricted stock, safety stock, and reorder point.

tools.name: sap_mm_get_vendor_master
tools.description: Retrieve vendor master data (XK03 equivalent) including lead time, rating, and preferred status for a given vendor number.

tools.name: sap_mm_get_purchase_order_status
tools.description: Retrieve purchase order status (ME23N equivalent) by PO number, including vendor, net price, delivery date, and status.

tools.name: sap_mm_create_purchase_requisition
tools.description: Stage a SAP MM purchase requisition (ME51N equivalent) for a spare-part procurement need. This tool only creates a draft requisition in the buyer's SAP workflow inbox and routes it to human approval before it can become a purchase order; it never releases a PO or commits spend directly. The service account used has no PO-release authority.
